mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE, V.LATEST_VIEW_DT AS viewDt FROM ( SELECT TARGET_ID, MAX(VIEW_DT) AS LATEST_VIEW_DT FROM VIEW_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY TARGET_ID ORDER BY LATEST_VIEW_DT DESC LIMIT 50 ) V INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON V.TARGET_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY V.LATEST_VIEW_DT DESC LIMIT ${pageSize} OFFSET ${offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VIEW_HISTORY ( USER_ID, TARGET_ID, VIEW_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{productId}, NOW() )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM VIEW_HISTORY WHERE VIEW_ID = ( SELECT VIEW_ID FROM ( SELECT VIEW_ID FROM VIEW_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY VIEW_DT ASC, VIEW_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) T )
